This application relates to a method for small file merging, characterized in that it comprises the steps of: filtering small files smaller than a preset value; merging the small files into cache blocks. This solution delivers superior read efficiency.

1. A method for small file merging, characterized in that it comprises the steps of:

filtering small files smaller than a preset value;

2. The method according to claim 1, characterized in that the method further comprises:

    merging the small files into cache blocks.

Small File Merging Method and System

Technical Field

This application relates to the field of micro file processing, and more specifically to a method and system for small file merging.

Background Art

Several defects exist in the prior art, resulting in low processing efficiency.

Summary of the Invention

In view of this, this application proposes a method for small file merging.
